title: Director, Software Engineering
description: <p><span>At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span>If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p> <p>We champion the builders of tomorrow by providing the infrastructure, tools, services, programs and support for creation on one of the world’s fastest, most sustainable and consistently reliable public blockchain - XRPL. By supporting an open community of developers, they can advance the solutions and innovation needed to allow businesses, consumers, institutions and governments to fuel the engine of a new digital economy.</p><p>We believe that realizing the Internet of Value hinges on how easily new technology works for more people, and how effectively we can change the way the world operates today.</p><p>Ripple Custody is helping more people participate in the digital economy by providing enterprise grade custody solutions for large financial institutions and crypto native companies.</p><p>We have a big vision and the ambition to match. We are seeking the same in engineering managers. You also see the huge potential of this crypto custody and have the entrepreneurial spirit and technical excellence to realize the vision we have. There is a lot of work to get there but we are committed to building out the best team to achieve this.</p><p>We’re looking for a results oriented hands-on engineering leader to help manage and guide teams building core security features for Ripple Custody.</p><p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p><ul><li>Provide technical and business leadership defining Ripple Custody’s long term strategy, ensuring flawless execution building secure software and systems that are scalable and reliable</li><li>Own and deliver the roadmaps of multiple programs while driving technical and operational excellence across the engineering organization</li><li>Mentor and guide the professional and technical development of your team, both managers and engineers</li><li>Provide hands-on technical leadership</li><li>Encourage and drive engineering best practices</li><li>Collaborate with stakeholders across Ripple and the customer community at large</li><li>Establish team objectives and quarterly plans in alignment with business and organizational goals</li><li>Translate technical concepts into tailored content for different audiences including engineers, business and technical leaders</li><li>Scale the team by attracting and mentoring great leaders and engineers at various levels of experience</li></ul><strong>What we're looking for</strong><ul><li>10+ years of hands-on software development leadership experience, managing managers and teams of engineers.</li><li>Solid leadership and communication skills.</li><li>Hands-on experience building highly secure, scalable distributed systems in modern technology stacks</li><li>Experience with Agile development with a focus on robust software design, scalability and security.</li><li>Eagerness to work openly and collaboratively with a diverse team, with a positive attitude and a passion for sharing knowledge.</li><li>A technical subject matter expert who provides technical leadership and shares expertise with a growing team of engineers.</li><li>BS in Computer Science or similar.</li></ul> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE:</strong></p><p><span>Do Your Best Work</span></p><ul><li><span>The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders</span></li><li><span>A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.&nbsp; A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.</span></li><li><span>Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.</span></li><li><span>In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.&nbsp;</span></li><li><span>Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team</span></li><li><span>We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!</span></li></ul><p><span>Take Control of Your Finances</span></p><ul><li><span>Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity</span></li><li><span>Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support</span></li><li><span>Employee giving match</span></li><li><span>Mobile phone stipend</span></li></ul><p><span>Take Care of Yourself</span></p><ul><li><span>R&amp;R days so you can rest and Family planning benefits.</span></li><li><span>Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events</span></li></ul><p><span><em>Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.&nbsp;</em></span></p><em>Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description: <em><strong>Are you an experienced Senior Engineering Manager with a passion for leading and inspiring high-performing engineering teams?<br><br></strong></em><em><strong>Thredd is looking for you to join our dynamic team and drive the delivery of innovative technology solutions in the fintech sector!<br><br></strong></em><strong>What you’ll be doing as a Senior Engineering Manager<br><br></strong><ul><li>Leadership &amp; Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback and coaching.</li><li>Project Management: Plan, coordinate, and oversee engineering projects from conception to completion. Work closely with product management, design, and other stakeholders to prioritize and plan feature development and releases.</li><li>Technical Oversight: Provide technical guidance in software design, coding, and deployment. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices.</li><li>Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement in development processes, tools, and infrastructure. Implement CI/CD practices to enhance our delivery pipeline.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What you will bring to the Senior Engineering Manager role <br><br></strong><ul><li>Excellent leadership and people management skills.</li><li>Software engineering background in Python and JavaScript.</li><li>Strong understanding of software development methodologies (FDD, Agile, Scrum).</li><li>Experience with AWS cloud platforms and SDLC tools (e.g., Jira, Bitbucket).<br><br></li></ul><strong>Where you'll work <br><br></strong>Our working model varies depending on the specific role and team requirements. We strive to provide flexibility whilst ensuring that each position is best supported for optimal collaboration and performance.<br><br>This Senior Engineering Manager position requires you to be in the London office (Holborn) minimum two days per week.<br><br><strong>About Us<br><br></strong>Thredd is the trusted next-gen payments partner for innovators looking to modernise their payments offering. Certified by Mastercard, Visa and Diners &amp; Discover, we process billions of debit, prepaid, and credit transactions annually, supporting consumer and corporate fintechs, digital banks, and embedded finance providers across the globe. Our unique offering is our client-centric approach, combining hands-on support with modern, reliable, and scalable technology.<br><br>Our assured solution accelerates the development and delivery of consumer and corporate payments components embedded within digital banks, as well as for expense management, B2B payments, crypto, lending, credit, Buy Now Pay Later, FX, remittance, and open banking innovators.<br><br>Since 2007, Thredd has enabled market leaders through our highly reliable, secure, and scalable platform and supported many of our client's growth journeys - from early-stage startup through to globally recognized unicorns, including Monzo, Revolut, and Starling.<br><br><strong>Diversity and Inclusion at Thredd<br><br></strong>Here at Thredd, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know and we would be happy to support you.<br><br><strong>Our Values<br><br></strong>Our values-driven culture is what unites our teams globally and our teams is what drives our success;<br><br>Here are what the values will mean for you in this Senior Engineering Manager position<br><br><ul><li>Own it and deliver – Taking responsibility for your own performance and being successful in your own role </li><li>Collaborate purposefully – Building trusted relationships with colleagues, supporting activities and being successful together </li><li>Think differently – Asking questions to check understanding and sharing your ideas to support continuous improvement </li><li>Act courageously – Stepping out of your comfort zone and embracing change to help you learn and grow</li></ul>

title: Software Engineering Manager
description: <em><strong>hackajob</strong> is collaborating with <strong>BBC</strong> to connect them with exceptional tech professionals for this role.<br><br></em>Job Title: Software Engineering Manager<br><br>JOB DETAILS<br><br>Band: E<br><br>Contract: Permanent, Full-time<br><br>Department: Digital Distribution - Media Services<br><br>Location: London or Salford (preferred), or Glasgow, Cardiff, Newcastle, or Birmingham, with regular travel to London/Salford as part of hybrid working<br><br>Salary: £110,000-£130,000 depending on skills and experience<br><br>We’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements. If you wish, you can outline your preference when you apply, but there’s no obligation at this stage.<br><br>PURPOSE OF THE ROLE<br><br>The BBC aims to be as strong in engineering as we are in content. Our digital products underpin our mission to inform, educate and entertain millions of people every day, and we’re looking for a Software Engineering Manager who can blend hands-on technical expertise with confident people leadership.<br><br>This is a unique opportunity for an experienced engineering leader who still enjoys engaging with technical decision-making. You will lead several multi-disciplinary teams who design, build and operate the BBC’s cloud-based media platform — ensuring it is scalable, resilient and ready for the BBC’s digital future.<br><br>You will develop and own the technical strategy for Media Services, working closely with product, architecture and operations partners. This is a role where your technical judgement and your leadership will have a tangible impact on the BBC’s audience-facing products.<br><br><strong>WHY JOIN THE TEAM<br><br></strong>Media Services sits at the heart of BBC Digital Distribution, powering iPlayer, BBC Sounds, News and Sport. Our systems handle more than 50 million daily plays and process thousands of hours of content every single day.<br><br>You’ll work with modern cloud technologies, a DevOps culture and teams who care deeply about engineering quality and continuous improvement. It’s an opportunity to help build products and services that truly matter — at a scale few organisations can match.<br><br><strong>Your Key Responsibilities And Impact<br><br></strong><ul><li> Lead and support several engineering teams delivering high-volume, high-availability media publishing workflows and consumer-facing services using AWS and modern frameworks.</li><li> Provide clear technical leadership, helping teams make thoughtful architectural and engineering decisions.</li><li> Recruit, mentor and develop engineering talent, creating an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing environment.</li><li> Shape and deliver the technical vision and strategy for Media Services in partnership with colleagues across Technology, Product Group and Media Operations.</li><li> Ensure our systems meet high standards of reliability, security and operational excellence.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Essential Criteria<br><br></strong><strong>YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE<br><br></strong><ul><li> Experience leading multiple engineering teams in an Agile environment, ideally with platform or infrastructure exposure.</li><li> A strong track record delivering complex, cloud-based solutions at scale (AWS preferable).</li><li> The ability to provide hands-on technical direction — whether through architecture, code review, prototyping or guiding engineering approaches.</li><li> Confident stakeholder management and the ability to influence across product, architecture and delivery teams.</li><li> Experience line-managing senior engineers and/or team leads and supporting their career development.<br><br></li></ul><strong>DESIRABLE CRITERIA<br><br></strong><ul><li> Familiarity with CI/CD and configuration tools such as AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, Terraform, CloudFormation or Ansible.</li><li> Experience with large-scale media platforms (VOD or live streaming).</li><li> Knowledge of threat-modelling frameworks or zero-trust approaches.</li><li> Experience with event-driven architectures and RESTful API design.</li><li> A passion for improving developer experience, tooling and engineering craft.<br><br></li></ul>Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Contracts of Employment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.

title: Senior Engineering Manager

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
description: Lab49 is an award-winning specialist consultancy that <strong>creates bespoke technology</strong> in partnership with the most important companies in finance.  We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.   <br><br>Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.  <br><br>Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers will work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.  <br><br><strong>Job Summary<br><br></strong>You will lead engineering teams delivering business-critical products and services for some of the largest financial institutions globally. These products are typically full-stack, modern, event-driven platforms based on microservices, using Enterprise Java, Spring Boot, and JavaScript front ends, operating in 2 week sprints over 6 to 18 months roadmaps.<br><br>You will be responsible for delivery timelines, code quality, team health, and delivery predictability, while also contributing to solution architecture and helping to evolve Lab49’s engineering practices.<br><br><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong><ul><li> Software Delivery Management:</li><li>Manage the full software development lifecycle for the products and services </li><li>Provide leadership and guidance to a team of 10 to 25 engineers, working with them and their team leads </li><li>Establish robust code review process, and personally review critical code components to ensure alignment with best practices, architectural vision, and coding standards </li><li>Monitor project timelines, manage risks, and ensure milestones are met through effective planning and coordination </li><li>Own quality of the code and efficiency and productivity of the team </li><li> Product Management:</li><li>Work together with the Product Owners, translating longer-term product roadmaps into multi-sprint backlogs, including effort estimation </li><li>Own the 6-9 months sizing at the completion of the discovery, with rolling re-estimation each quarter </li><li> People and Team Management:</li><li>Coach and retain talent across multiple teams </li><li>Run regular 1-1s, personal development and project feedback sessions </li><li>Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level developers </li><li> Stakeholder Collaboration: </li><li>Collaborate with Lab49’s stakeholders (product owners, architects, UI leads) to understand requirements and design, plan, develop, and implement software solutions </li><li>Act as a representative of the engineering team in front of Client’s Product Management, Technology and Business stakeholders </li><li>Present delivery status, risks, and mitigation plans in clear, data-driven language <br><br></li></ul><strong>Required Experience And Skills<br><br></strong><ul><li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years leading teams of 10 or more engineers </li><li>Expert in Java and SpringBoot, hands-on in microservices, REST, messaging </li><li>Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS, for building and deploying applications </li><li>Experience in leading and managing development teams effectively </li><li>Experience working in an agile, product-oriented delivery environment </li><li>Experience working in digital-native Consulting or Software Development companies in a client-facing roles (pre-sale, architect, client-facing delivery manager or tech lead) </li><li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for collaborating with team members and stakeholders <br><br></li></ul><strong>Preferable / Nice To Have Experience And Skills<br><br></strong><ul><li>Master’s degree is preferred. </li><li>Some experience with front-end technology (React, Angular, etc) </li><li>Experience with Financial Services, incl. Banking, Payments, Capital Markets <br><br></li></ul><strong>Why Lab49?<br><br></strong>Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant. <br><br><strong>Lab49/ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.<br><br></strong><strong>Lab49/ION adheres to an equal employment opportunity policy that prohibits discriminatory practices or harassment against applicants or employees based on any legally impermissible factor.</strong>

title: Senior Engineering Manager | UK
description: <strong>About The Company<br><br></strong><strong>About Cleo<br><br></strong>At Cleo, we're not just building another fintech app. We're embarking on a mission to fundamentally change humanity's relationship with money. Imagine a world where everyone, regardless of background or income, has access to a hyper-intelligent financial advisor in their pocket. That's the future we're creating.<br><br>Cleo is a rare success story: a profitable, fast-growing unicorn with over $200 million in ARR and growing over 2x year-over-year. This isn't just a job; it's a chance to join a team of brilliant, driven individuals who are passionate about making a real difference. We have an exceptionally high bar for talent, seeking individuals who are not only at the top of their field but also embody our culture of collaboration and positive impact.<br><br>If you’re driven by complex challenges that push your expertise, the chance to shape something truly transformative, and the potential to share in Cleo’s success as we scale, while growing alongside a company that’s scaling fast, this might be your perfect fit.<br><br>Follow us on LinkedIn to keep up to date with new product features and insights from the team.<br><br>The Role<br><br>Cleo is radically different from the norm and we’re looking for a senior engineering manager to guide and further develop our engineers across our cross functional product squads. You will be responsible for the teams and pillar technical delivery as they create exceptional products for our customers, as well as the wellbeing and development of your reports.<br><br>You’ll be responsible for all people management of multiple squads and engineers within a pillar. This means hiring the right spread of TL’s, engineers (juniors, seniors and leads), and then coaching and developing them to deliver on the roadmap. You’ll build out the headcount plan and will be responsible for all hiring and team development within your area to support our growth.<br><br>You’ll be accountable for all engineering needs for multiple squads working closely with your counterparts in product, data and experience to build high-performing cross-functional teams so that they deliver impact on our company mission in the most effective way possible. We’ll also be looking to you to develop some of our current squad-focused Leads into more senior positions to support you in the future.<br><br>You’ll be responsible for all technical leadership; this means actively seeking out opportunities to improve or optimise processes, participating in design sessions, reviewing technical proposals and developing the technical roadmap for your area.<br><br>Want to hear directly from the team? Check out this blog post from a few of our engineering managers. <br><br><strong>About You<br><br></strong>We’re looking for a<strong> Senior Engineering Manager</strong> that has exceptional people leadership skills, with an understanding of building a culture of technical excellence. On top of this:<br><br><ul><li>You are the kind of manager who is people first, technology second. We build environments to support our engineers to be the most impactful engineers possible. We have to strike the right balance between short term gains and longer term sustainability, and our engineering principles reflect this.</li><li>You have previously been a hands-on software developer, but these days get your kicks from software architecture and organisation design, debugging people and processes, and delivering through others.</li><li>You are a great communicator. We are a tight-knit engineering management team, who support one another to be the best leaders possible. You need to be comfortable challenging and supporting us. </li><li>You are comfortable with change and can adapt to constantly changing circumstances. We’re growing the team, and we want you to grow with us on that journey. </li><li>You practise a learning and growth mindset. We move quickly and experiment lots and we need you to help people learn and grow from their experiences. <br><br></li></ul>Our Tech Stack<br><br>Cleo is built as a Ruby on Rails monolith with a single React Native app frontend, utilising TypeScript. We also leverage Python for machine learning services and PostgreSQL for our database, all hosted on AWS. Our CI/CD pipeline is fully automated, with production deployments happening on every merge via Heroku. Our backend engineers deploy multiple times a week, and we release our frontend app to Google and Apple for review at least once a week.<br><br>While we take a pragmatic approach, we place a strong emphasis on quality. Our code is peer-reviewed, and we maintain automated testing using Minitest and CircleCI. We're also actively working towards a more modular architecture, focusing on separating concerns to achieve all the benefits of microservices within a monolith, while progressively refactoring our code as we build new features. Everyone in the engineering team contributes to driving our technical strategy, voices &amp; ideas from all levels are valued: we are all owners at Cleo.<br><br>What do you get for all your hard work?<br><br><ul><li>A competitive compensation package (base + equity) with bi-annual reviews, aligned to our quarterly OKR planning cycles. You can view our public progression framework and salary bandings here: https://cleo-ai.progressionapp.com/ </li><li>Work at one of the fastest-growing tech startups, backed by top VC firms, Balderton &amp; EQT Ventures</li><li>A clear progression plan. We want you to keep growing. That means trying new things, leading others, challenging the status quo and owning your impact. Always with our complete support. </li><li>Flexibility. We can’t fight for the world’s financial health if we’re not healthy ourselves. We work with everyone to make sure they have the balance they need to do their best work</li><li>Work where you work best. We’re a globally distributed team. Our Poland team works fully remotely, but we host virtual socials and an annual company offsite somewhere in Europe with all expenses paid.</li><li>Other benefits;</li><li>Company-wide performance reviews every 6 months </li><li>Generous pay increases for high-performing team members</li><li>Equity top-ups for team members getting promoted</li><li>25 days annual leave a year + public holidays (+ an additional day for every year you spend at Cleo, up to 30 days)</li><li>Private medical insurance via Vitality, dental cover, and life assurance</li><li>1 month paid sabbatical after 4 years at Cleo</li><li>Regular socials and activities, online and in-person</li><li>We'll pay for your OpenAI subscription</li><li>Online mental health support via Spill</li><li>Enhanced parental leave</li><li>Workplace Nursery Scheme </li><li>And many more!<br><br></li></ul><em>We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.<br><br></em><em>If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.<br><br></em><strong>UK App access:</strong> The Cleo app is no longer downloadable in the UK. If you’re an existing user, you’ll still have access to the app. But some features won’t be available. Why? 99% of our users are based in the US – where financial health is often overlooked. We’ve decided to shift our focus to where we can provide the most value and make the greatest impact for users who need it most. title: Engineering Director
description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong>Wise is one the fastest growing companies in Europe and we’re on a mission: to make money without borders the new normal. We’ve got 15 million customers across the globe and we’re growing. Fast.<br><br>Current banking systems don’t let us send, spend or receive money across borders easily. Or quickly. Or cheaply.<br><br>So, we’re building a new one.<br><br>Enter: our Global Product Tribe!<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>The Global Product tribe at Wise owns nearly all aspects of the customer experience and core infrastructure powering the Wise Account, Wise Business, and Remittances (Transfer) products. We’re on a mission to build the world’s most global account—one that offers a truly local experience no matter where life or business takes our customers.<br><br>If you’ve used Wise, there’s a good chance you’ve spent 90% of your time engaging with products and experiences developed by teams in this tribe.<br><br>The tribe is organized into six key squads: Onboarding, Send, Receive, Spend, Account, and Grow—each responsible for a specific area of the product journey.<br><br>We’re looking for an inspiring and customer-obsessed engineering leader to join us—someone with a bias for action, a strong product mindset, and a passion for world-class user experiences. You’ll start by leading our Receive Squad, with the opportunity to grow your scope across more of the Global Product organization in the future.<br><br><strong>About The Receive Squad<br><br></strong>The Receive Squad builds the products that allow Wise customers to get paid from anywhere in the world and fund their accounts and transactions. Our goal is to offer the fastest, most transparent, most convenient, and fairly priced ways for customers to receive money globally.<br><br>Today, we provide local account details in 10+ countries, and our PayIn platform processes over £200 billion annually in incoming payments. We're also laying the foundation for payment facilitation capabilities to support merchants and global businesses. As the world becomes more interconnected, our customers increasingly rely on Wise to handle all their payment needs through a single global account.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Drive the technical and product direction for engineering teams within the Receive Squad, aligning closely with product and design leads to build customer-first solutions.</li><li>Be hands-on when needed—with a strong eye for system design, you’ll dive into technical details to help teams make smart architectural decisions and unblock complex challenges.</li><li>Build and scale high-performing engineering teams that can support Wise’s continued hypergrowth and complex global operations.</li><li>Unblock teams and enable them to move faster in an increasingly large and complex global organization by reducing inefficiencies, cutting unnecessary admin, and improving team focus.</li><li>Navigate risk, compliance, and regulatory challenges while maintaining agility—working iteratively to release product improvements without compromising safety or speed.</li><li>Collaborate closely with neighbouring tribes—including Regional (local payment schemes, regulators, tailoring product to local needs), Finance &amp; Treasury (safeguarding, liquidity management, accounting &amp; reporting), and Servicing (Financial Crime, KYC, and account monitoring)—to ensure alignment across Wise’s global platform.</li><li>Influence and align with Wise’s broader technical and product vision across squads and tribes.</li><li>Mentor engineering managers and technical leads, and create the conditions for autonomous, empowered teams to thrive.</li><li>Champion a healthy engineering culture rooted in continuous improvement, technical excellence, and customer-centricity.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What’s In It For You<br><br></strong><ul><li>A chance to lead the teams building the core infrastructure powering a global financial platform used by millions.</li><li>The opportunity to shape Wise’s global account experience as we scale to serve more regions, more use cases, and more complexity.</li><li>A key role in navigating the intersection of tech, regulation, finance, and customer experience, working across Wise’s most critical domains.</li><li>The ability to make a tangible difference by simplifying internal operations and accelerating delivery—enabling your teams to do their best work.</li><li>A collaborative, no-blame culture built on transparency, ownership, and trust.</li><li>The autonomy to build and scale teams your way—supported by strong peers and leadership who care deeply about impact and people.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>You’re an experienced engineering leader who has led complex, high-impact teams at scale.</li><li>You care deeply about building products that solve real customer problems—and you bring that empathy into how you lead and prioritize.</li><li>You bring a strong technical foundation, with a solid eye for system design, architecture, and scalability, and you’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and go deep when teams need help.</li><li>You’ve worked in or with regulated industries and know how to balance compliance, speed, and customer value.</li><li>You’re energized by removing blockers, simplifying processes, and enabling teams to ship faster.</li><li>You’re comfortable leading in a globally distributed, cross-functional environment and collaborating across a diverse set of teams.</li><li>You thrive in a high-growth, high-accountability culture where autonomy and trust go hand in hand.<br><br></li></ul>Additional Information<br><br>For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.<br><br>We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.<br><br>Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.<br><br>If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.<br><br>Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Technical Director - Mechanical Engineering
description: Mott MacDonald are a global engineering, management and development consultancy. Our purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes in everything we do, relentlessly focusing on excellence and digital innovation, transforming our clients’ businesses, our communities and employee opportunities.<br><br>The need to develop services that can meet tomorrow’s-built environment needs, means that Mott MacDonald has never been more involved in shaping global net zero carbon policy and facility provision.<br><br>Your role will be to support the Buildings Health division sector technical team in supporting the expansion of healthcare work in the UK and Europe.<br><br>We want to recruit a candidate who will provide healthcare sector business development and subsequent technical delivery leadership as part of the teams delivering built environment healthcare projects. The role will include technically led bid activity and client relationship building – primarily through thought leadership on matters such as site decarbonisation and the adaption and/or replacement of existing MEP engineering systems, inclusion of MMC/DfMA design solutions, structural adaption, etc. The candidate will be self-motivated and capable of delivering high quality technical advisory services with the minimum of supervision to time and budget. As part of a wider practice network the role will support the Healthcare sector team who have developed a strong reputation for work winning, successful project delivery and technical excellence.<br><br>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate and take positive steps to create an inclusive culture.<br><br>The opportunity now exists for an individual to join this enthusiastic and growing team and to develop their career within the built environment sector at Mott MacDonald.<br><br>you will: -<br><br><ul><li> Have responsibility for all aspects of assigned project work, and with a focus on healthcare sector built environment projects.</li><li> Support national core teams of project delivery staff on technical aspects of healthcare projects – developing/mentoring the teams to successfully deliver healthcare sector projects.</li><li> Working and liaising with associated engineering disciplines as part of bidding and delivering technical support.</li><li> Client facing on matters of a technical nature.</li><li> Support senior managers running the commercial and contractual side of built environment projects.<br><br></li></ul>As a Director level engineer you will be involved in a range of small to large projects within our built environment sector project delivery team. The role will be challenging, demanding, varied and offer opportunities for skill set and career development.<br><br>You will work autonomously within a team carrying out technical advisory commissions, with a bias towards MEP (and some strategic Structural) engineering design. You will potentially manage several projects and the work of others.<br><br>The key elements of the role are (but not limited to);<br><br><ul><li> Managing the delivery of assigned built environment technical advisory projects.</li><li> Working and liaising with associated engineering disciplines as part of delivering projects – primarily focussed on the health sector.</li><li> Management of internal and external stakeholders.</li><li> Responsible for managing external stakeholders, ensuring client satisfaction and pursuing and promoting opportunities with potential and established clients.</li><li> Be familiar with using relevant industry software (eg, IES, Revit, ADB Codebook, DRofus, etc).</li><li> Developing, maintaining and monitoring programmes for scheduling and reporting on deliverables across specific projects.</li><li> Maximising profitability of projects, monitoring against budget, reacting and anticipating potential problems and communicating in line with client expectations.</li><li> Demonstrating technical expertise, providing in depth knowledge whilst proactively coaching and developing less experienced team members.<br><br></li></ul>A Fully Qualified And Experienced Professional Having The Breadth Of Experience, Ability And Maturity To Make Good Decisions Across The Key Areas Of Their Recognised Built Environment Discipline And Demonstrating The Following Attributes<br><br><ul><li> Have experience of leading on building commissions.</li><li> Have experience of mentoring and leading graduate engineers</li><li> Be enthusiastic and ambitious.</li><li> Possess excellent communication skills, including report writing and presentation.</li><li> Have the ability to lead elements of one large project or a portfolio of smaller projects.</li><li> Have experience of managing client relationships and expectations with accountability for key customer relationships and delivery of outputs.</li><li> Working as a specialist providing high level advice to others.</li><li> Track record of achievement and innovation, delivering complex projects or new services.</li><li> Managing and supervising the work of other professionally qualified staff.</li><li> Well-developed professional network externally and desire to build internal networks within the organisation.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Flexible working<br><br></strong>At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.<br><br>Location(s):<br><br>London, GB<br><strong><br>Contract Type:</strong> Permanent<br><strong><br>Work Pattern:</strong> Full Time<br><br>Market: Buildings<br><strong><br>Discipline:</strong> Building services<br><strong><br>Job Ref:</strong> 9277<br><strong><br>Recruiter Contact:</strong> David McFall / Chris Reybould

title: Structural Engineering Director - Specialist Teams Lead
description: <strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>We are interested in hearing from you if you have the skill, experience and passion to support our growth in the delivery of technically challenging projects.<br><br>We invite you to bring your expertise and enthusiasm to a newly created role to lead our Specialist Teams who are a key part of our UK Building Structures Team. Our Specialist Teams work across the core Ramboll markets with a growth opportunity presented by our mounting portfolio of projects in our Defence and Government sectors.<br><br>The role will include leadership of our seismic and advanced engineering teams who specialise in;<br><br><br><ul><li> Seismic design and analysis</li><li> Advanced Engineering Simulation</li><li> Dynamics</li><li> Blast</li><li> Finite Element Analysis</li><li> 3D computational design</li><li> Point cloud processing<br><br><br></li></ul>As Specialist Teams Lead, you will have technical and commercial accountability for these teams, report into one of our Regional Heads of Department and support our other Directors across our UK Building Structures Team to strengthen our reputation and offering in our growth sectors.<br><br>To succeed in this role, you must have a broad technical grounding and understanding across our specialist areas alongside being client focused, with a strong ability to simplify and communicate complex ideas in plain language. Are you our new Director?<br><br><strong>You will join our UK Building Structures team <br><br></strong>As a new Director in UK Building Structures, you will be part of a dynamic team of over 180 engineers and technicians, working on a range of projects, with a in depth focus on technical delivery and an excellent understanding of client care.<br><br>Our specialist teams work from multiple office locations and as such this will be a national role with occasional requirement for travel. We promote home and hybrid working however candidates will be required to travel into one of our key office locations, which include Birmingham, Bristol, Cambridge, Chester, London, Leeds, Manchester and Southampton.<br><br>We offer a supporting and collaborative culture and environment, in which you can develop and grow in your role. For the right candidate there is the opportunity to progress rapidly, with increasing ownership of client relationships and leadership of our most complex projects. Working with leading architects we are recognised for our bold innovative approach, that is underpinned by our Scandinavian design heritage and foundation ownership.<br><br>Finally, we enjoy what we do! And are looking for naturally curious and personable people to join and strengthen our team.<br><br><strong>Your key tasks and responsibilities will include:<br><br><br></strong><ul><li> Provide leadership and line management to our specialist seismic and advanced engineering teams (currently 5 engineers)</li><li> Plan and manage the growth of our specialist teams</li><li> Develop our specialist teams to support the growth aspirations of the business; including in the Defence and Government sectors</li><li> Accountable for the technical and commercial performance of the specialist teams including reporting to the UK Structures Leadership team</li><li> Responsible for increasing Ramboll’s technical capability and reputation in specialist fields</li><li> Provide a direct linkage between the specialist teams and the project delivery teams</li><li> Act as client liaison to simply explain high complexity or technically challenging work undertaken by your team</li><li> Develop client business relationships through building trust and reputation for technical excellence</li><li> Represent Ramboll at external client meetings responding to their requirements and needs</li><li> Manage the day-to-day activities in the team, both from a commercial and technical perspective</li><li> Develop and agree structural concepts, design philosophies and undertake inception and peer reviews</li><li> Take ownership as Structural lead or Design Lead on our complex and specialist projects<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Your starting point for constant growth <br><br></strong>From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:<br><br><br><ul><li> Educated to a degree level or equivalent in structural / civil engineering</li><li> Chartered with the IStructE, ICE or international equivalent</li><li> Demonstratable experience at Associate Structural Engineer level or above</li><li> An excellent communicator capable of explaining complex engineering principles in plain language, verbally, in writing and through sketching</li><li> Great with people, diverse in your outlook and with something different to bring to the table</li><li> The role requires you to be able to obtain UK Government Security Clearance<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Technical competencies and proven experience: <br><br><br></strong><ul><li> Demonstrable experience of leading technically complex projects</li><li> Demonstratable evidence of leading projects with multiple technical and non-technical stakeholders</li><li> Evidence of providing technical leadership to a team of structural engineers with specialist or niche skills</li><li> A broad knowledge and technical understanding of;</li><li> Structural seismic analysis and detailing to international and local codes of practice (e.g. European, American, New Zealand, etc.)</li><li> Seismic assessment and retrofit of existing structures</li><li> Dynamic and non-linear analysis</li><li> Blast analysis and design</li><li> Design codes, industry standards, and performance-based design approaches appropriate for safety critical industries</li><li> Knowledge of structural engineering software and specialist finite-element analysis software (e.g. ETABS, CSI SAFE, ANSYS, DIANA etc.)</li><li> Ability to approach engineering problems and develop solutions from first principles for situations that fall outside of codified methods</li><li> Experience of managing staff working in coding languages is desirable (e.g. Python, JavaScript)<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role include: <br><br><br></strong><ul><li> Ambition to lead and grow a team</li><li> Able to converge technical and non-technical viewpoints</li><li> Able to fulfil a national role, leading people in multiple geographic locations</li><li> A curiosity to explore – ‘is there a better way to do this’</li><li> Happy to ask questions and to answer them!</li><li> Willingness to take responsibility for your projects<br><br><br></li></ul><strong>The Partner for Sustainable Change <br><br></strong>Ramboll is a global engineering, architecture and consultancy company founded in Denmark in 1945. We are a responsible business and sustainable practices have been part of Ramboll’s DNA since the company’s inception. Ramboll was the first engineering consultancy in the world to be certified after the UN sustainable development goals. This year we sat a bold direction for the coming four years and launched our new business strategy: The Partner for Sustainable Change. Together we enable our stakeholders to realise their goals and navigate the transition to a more sustainable future. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world.<br><br><strong>Ramboll in the United Kingdom<br><br></strong>Ramboll is ranked a Top 10 consultant in the UK and has 1,300 bright minds working across 17 offices to apply their passion to deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Environment &amp; Health and Energy. We love seeing our talents develop and succeed and you will have opportunities to work on challenging and inspiring projects within an environment that is friendly, open and supportive. Our Buildings division is one of the top 10 building designers in the world. We place particular emphasis on our liveable buildings concept where we balance the cultural, social and physical values of buildings, to improve the quality of life for building users.<br><br>Ramboll believe in work-life balance and operate a flexible working policy. As a company with an increasingly agile workforce, we are open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate. We also offer a competitive salary, alongside 27 days holiday per year, and private medical insurance.<br><br><strong>An equal opportunity employer<br><br></strong>Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We invite applications from candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. As a Disability Confident Committed employer, Ramboll ensures opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please reach out to our recruitment team to discuss any adjustments that you might require during the application process. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when and how much you work. When you join Ramboll, you’ll have the freedom to work your hours flexibly and our positive approach.<br><br><strong>How To Apply<br><br></strong>Apply online. Attach your CV, cover letter and relevant documents showcasing why you are the right fit for the role, and when you are available to start. We look forward to receiving your application<br><br><strong>Additional Information<br><br></strong>All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
